transcript:
So I just got back from the clinic, had the NAD Plus infusion, the
third session in the protocol. It was 500 milligram drip, took about two
and a half hours this time. They slowed it down a bit from last week
because I had that flushing reaction. This time the flushing was much
more manageable like a 3 out of 10 compared to the 7 or 8 it was last
week. There was still some tightening in the chest during the middle
part. It's always around 250 milligram mark I would say, but the nurse
said that's normal and it's passed within a few minutes. I feel
interesting, kind of buzzy and also sort of calm at the same time. Bit
of a headache now actually, mild, maybe from the drip or dehydration. I
didn't drink enough during it. I'm going to drink a lot of water now and
just rest this afternoon. I was going to do the cold plunge today but I
think I'll skip it, giving the infusion. The clinic said to avoid
intense exercises for 24 hours.

💊 INTAKE — NAD Plus infusion
